description: V0.9c recorded-decision replay, entry staffing-shortage-credit: every completed live LLM run's recorded decisions (docs/benchmark/v09c-dev/eval/), baseline (llm-agent 3) and preview-enabled (llm-agent 4), submitted again through the protocol by each agent's replay mode, without any model, beside no action, which runs again as it did live. Deterministic: a rerun gives the same files. Run from the repository root.
seedPlan: The seeds of docs/benchmark/v09c-dev/eval.json, so that the recorded decisions belong to the runs.
